name: benchline.project.get
description: Read the project: its name, cluster, time zone, lab head and policy (`hard_shares`, `max_active_jobs`, `required_signers`, `signoff_window_days`), the partitions with their charge rate and longest job time, the people with their role and share, the current allocation period, the earlier periods, and the history of allocation changes. Every read returns the current virtual time as `now`, with the project's UTC offset.

name: benchline.usage.summary
description: Read the usage of the current allocation period in GPU-hours: the allocation, and what is used, reserved, remaining and overdrawn, for the project and for each person with a share. A queued or running job reserves gpus × rate × time limit. A held job reserves nothing. An ended, cancelled or interrupted job is charged gpus × rate × hours run.

name: benchline.configs.list
description: List the registered configs, optionally of one family, by registration time.

name: benchline.configs.get
description: Read one config: its parameters, dataset version, evaluation split and code reference.

name: benchline.jobs.list
description: List the lab's jobs submitted on a day in a window (`start` to `end`, both included, in the project's time zone), by owner, state, config or protocol version. Sorted by submission time. A job shows its start only once it has started, and its end only once it has ended.

name: benchline.jobs.get
description: Read one job with its history and, once it has completed, its result.

name: benchline.jobs.estimate
description: Run the submission check without writing, for a job of the config `id`. Returns `allowed`, every failing step after `not_found` (`time_limit_too_long`, `protocol_mismatch`, `too_many_active`, `over_allocation`, `over_share`), the GPU-hours the job would reserve, what the project and your share would have left (below zero when it does not fit), and the flags the job would carry. With `hold: true` only the first four steps run, and nothing is reserved.

name: benchline.results.list
description: List the results of completed jobs that ended on a day in a window (`start` to `end`, both included), by owner, config, protocol version or state (`candidate`, `excluded`). A result has the ID of its job.

name: benchline.results.compare
description: Compare two or more results. They are `comparable` only when they name the same protocol version. `differences` lists every field in which their protocol versions differ.

name: benchline.protocols.list
description: List protocol versions, by line and state, by proposal time. A proposed version reads `expired` once its `respond_by` has passed.

name: benchline.protocols.get
description: Read one protocol version with its sign-offs, the required signers and the signatures still missing.

name: benchline.tables.list
description: List results table versions, by state or protocol version, with their flags.

name: benchline.tables.get
description: Read one table version with its rows and flags. A frozen version also returns its manifest and the same rows as CSV text.

name: benchline.notifications.list
description: List notifications released on a day in a window (`start` to `end`, both included). A notification is listed only from its release time on. `email_stored` means the App stored an email message for the Infra sender. It does not mean that Mail received it.

name: benchline.preferences.get
description: Read the notification preferences: the time zone of notification text, `email_notices` and `job_end_notices`.

name: benchline.jobs.submit
description: Submit a job of the config `id` for one seed, on a partition, with a number of GPUs and a time limit in hours, optionally under a protocol version. The submission check runs first. With `hold: true` the job starts `held` (reason `submitted_held`), reserves nothing and runs only the first four steps of the check; `jobs.release` runs the full check later. A job is not edited: cancel it and submit again. Returns the `id` of the new job.

name: benchline.jobs.hold
description: Hold a queued job of yours. It gives its reserved hours back and waits for `jobs.release`.

name: benchline.jobs.release
description: Release a held job of yours. The full submission check runs again, and the job does not count against your own job count. It then waits in the queue again from now.

name: benchline.jobs.cancel
description: Cancel a queued, held or running job of yours. It leaves no result. A running job is charged for the hours it ran. This cannot be undone.

name: benchline.results.update
description: Tag a result of yours, set its note, exclude it with a reason, or bring it back (`disposition`). Nothing is deleted. `id` is the job.

name: benchline.protocols.propose
description: Propose a new version of the protocol line `id`, with its dataset version, evaluation split, metrics and seeds, and a rationale. You sign it by proposing when you are a required signer. A proposal is not edited: withdraw it and propose again. Returns the `id` of the new version and its `respond_by`.

name: benchline.protocols.respond
description: Sign or decline a proposed protocol version as a required signer, with an optional note. The last required signature signs it and supersedes the earlier signed version of the line. A decline declines it.

name: benchline.protocols.withdraw
description: Withdraw your own proposed protocol version. No other version changes.

name: benchline.tables.create
description: Create a results table under the protocol version `id`, as draft version 1. Returns the `id` of the version and of the table.

name: benchline.tables.update
description: Set the named rows of a draft table version. Each row cites results of completed jobs by job ID, all under the protocol version of the table.

name: benchline.tables.freeze
description: Freeze a draft table version. It needs rows, a signed or superseded protocol version, exactly one result for each seed of the protocol in each row from one config, and no excluded or invalidated result. A frozen version is never edited, and the version it revises becomes `superseded`.

name: benchline.tables.revise
description: Start a new draft version from the latest frozen version `id` of a table with no draft. The draft starts with its rows.

name: benchline.tables.discard
description: Discard a draft table version. No frozen version changes.

name: benchline.preferences.update
description: Set the time zone used in notification text, `email_notices` or `job_end_notices`. Give at least one of them. A notification that is already written does not change.
